{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the premise: internal test orders have revenue = 999999.99
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Check if any row has revenue = 999999.99
has_internal_test = internal_test_count > 0

# If no internal test orders exist, then the 'exclude' constraint is vacuously satisfied
if not has_internal_test:
    print("No internal test orders found. Proceeding with all completed orders.")
    # Filter only completed orders
    completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
    # Convert revenue to float
    completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Compute total revenue
    total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].sum()
    print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")
    print(total_revenue)
else:
    # If they exist, exclude them
    completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
    completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    non_test_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]
    total_revenue = non_test_orders['revenue_float'].sum()
    print(f"Total revenue from completed, non-test orders: {total_revenue}")
    print(total_revenue)"}
